locale.name: Persian
locale.notes: Machine-drafted; not reviewed by a native speaker. Scripture samples (preferencesDialog.typographyPreviewLine and the Fonts-section Bible sample preferencesDialog.fontSampleBible) use the Persian Old Version (ترجمه قدیم / Persian Old Version, 1895) — public domain — quoted from memory of John 3:16, so a reviewer should verify the wording against a printed or digital copy of that edition. Do NOT replace it with a modern copyrighted translation (e.g. Persian Contemporary Bible / ترجمه هزاره نو, Today's Persian Version / ترجمه تفسیری, or other modern editions). The theme preview (ui.preferences.themePreviewLine1/Line2) quotes John 3:16-17 from the same Old Version; ui.preferences.themePreviewLink is the phrase «حیات جاودانی» taken verbatim from Line1, because it is spliced back into that sentence at render time. Terminology: کتاب (book), باب (chapter), آیه (verse), عهد عتیق / عهد جدید; «پنل» is used for pane, «زبانه» for tab, «ماژول» for module, «پرونده» for the File menu, «فرهنگ لغت» for dictionary and «واژه‌نامه» for lexicon, «تفسیر» for commentary, «برجسته‌سازی» for highlight, «نشانک» for bookmark. Labels use nouns/infinitives; documentation prose uses the polite plural imperative. Layout descriptions that name physical sides (layout.*.description, splitRight/splitDown, left/right arrows in the docs) are translated literally and must be revisited together if pane geometry is mirrored for RTL. Menu-path arrows in strings use ← (and ◂) so they point the right way in RTL text.
